title: pinned_pubkeys_snapshot lacks the durable fallback; DAO signer fallback diverges from indexed pin lookup after restart
description: Found by robustness review of project-LICHEN-worker6-dowx. pinned_pubkey_for (announce.rs:287-302) now consults the durable store on memory miss, but pinned_pubkeys_snapshot (announce.rs:310-325) is still memory-only. node.rs resolve_dao_signer_from_bounded_snapshot (384-391) uses the indexed lookup first and the snapshot only when it misses; after restart or in-memory eviction a durably-pinned key is authoritative in the indexed view yet invisible to the snapshot, so a DAO that the fallback should resolve returns UnknownKey. Fails closed (no wrong accept) - consistency gap only. Either give the snapshot a bounded durable-scan path or document that fallback resolution is memory-only.
